# RelativePanel

Header: `winui/ui/panels/RelativePanel.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/panels/RelativePanel.hpp`.

Lays out children relative to each other and to the panel's edges.

Each child carries a [ui::RelativePanelConstraints](#struct-relativepanelconstraints) (sixteen constraints). A child is measured in the room its constraints leave it, then pinned: stretched between two anchored edges, placed against one, centered, or in the top-left corner when nothing is set. On the same side, a panel alignment wins over a sibling alignment, which wins over left_of/right_of. Siblings are resolved before the children that refer to them, whatever order they were added in. A constraint that would make a cycle, or that names a non-child, is ignored. The panel asks for the widest and tallest dependency chain plus its border and padding. [`ui::RelativePanel`](#uirelativepanel) is the declarative form, referring to siblings by name.

Example: 
```cpp
auto panel = std::make_unique<ui::RelativePanelControl>();
panel->set_padding(ui::Thickness{12.0f});
auto* title  = panel->add(std::make_unique<ui::TextControl>("Title"));
auto* ok     = panel->add(std::make_unique<ui::ButtonControl>("OK"), {.align_right_with_panel = true});
auto* cancel = panel->add(std::make_unique<ui::ButtonControl>("Cancel"), {.left_of = ok});
panel->add(std::make_unique<ui::TextControl>("Body"), {.below = title});
panel->set_constraints(ok, {.below = title, .align_right_with_panel = true}); // re-pin later
cancel->on_click([] { /* ... */ });
window.set_content(std::move(panel));

// Declaratively:
auto node = ui::build(ui::RelativePanel{.content = {
    ui::RelativeItem{.name = "a", .content = ui::Text{.text = "A"}},
    ui::RelativeItem{.right_of = "a", .content = ui::Text{.text = "B"}},
}});
```

## `ui::RelativePanel`

Children placed relative to each other and to the panel. Builds a [ui::RelativePanelControl](#uirelativepanelcontrol).

Example: 
```cpp
window.set_content(ui::RelativePanel{
    .padding  = ui::Thickness{12.0f},
    .width    = 280.0f,
    .content  = {
        ui::RelativeItem{.name                  = "image",
                         .align_left_with_panel = true,
                         .align_top_with_panel  = true,
                         .content = ui::Image{.source = ui::Bitmap::read("cover.jpg"), .width = 80.0f}},
        ui::RelativeItem{.name = "title", .right_of = "image", .align_top_with = "image",
                         .content = ui::Text{.text = "Title", .role = ui::TextRole::BodyStrong}},
        ui::RelativeItem{.right_of = "image", .below = "title", .content = ui::Text{.text = "Subtitle"}},
    },
});
```

Every field, in the order a designated initializer names them:

```cpp
ui::RelativePanel{
    .background, .border_brush, .border_thickness, .corner_radius, .padding, .style, .margin,
    .width, .height, .min_width, .min_height, .max_width, .max_height, .horizontal_alignment,
    .vertical_alignment, .visible, .tool_tip, .enabled, .accessibility, .on_pointer_entered,
    .on_pointer_exited, .on_got_focus, .on_lost_focus, .on_key_down, .on_wheel, .control,
    .content
}
```

Fields, in declaration order (designators must follow it):

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <span id="uirelativepanel-background"></span>`background` | `ui::Binding<ui::Paint>` |  | Background: a [Color](../core/color.md), or a [ThemeColor](../tree/theme-color.md) read from the theme; empty (the default) draws none. |
| <span id="uirelativepanel-border_brush"></span>`border_brush` | `ui::Binding<ui::Paint>` |  | [Border](border.md#uiborder) color, a [Color](../core/color.md) or a [ThemeColor](../tree/theme-color.md); empty (the default) draws no border. |
| <span id="uirelativepanel-border_thickness"></span>`border_thickness` | `ui::Binding<ui::Thickness>` |  | [Border](border.md#uiborder) width per edge, DIPs. |
| <span id="uirelativepanel-corner_radius"></span>`corner_radius` | `ui::Binding<float>` | `{0.0f}` | Corner radius, DIPs. |
| <span id="uirelativepanel-padding"></span>`padding` | `ui::Binding<ui::Thickness>` |  | Padding between the border and the children, DIPs. |
| <span id="uirelativepanel-on_pointer_entered"></span>`on_pointer_entered` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer moved onto the control. |
| <span id="uirelativepanel-on_pointer_exited"></span>`on_pointer_exited` | `ui::Action` |  | The pointer left the control. |
| <span id="uirelativepanel-on_got_focus"></span>`on_got_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus arrived on the control, or on anything inside it, from outside it. A control with nothing focusable in it never gets focus, and never raises this. |
| <span id="uirelativepanel-on_lost_focus"></span>`on_lost_focus` | `ui::Action` |  | Keyboard focus left the control and everything inside it. |
| <span id="uirelativepanel-on_key_down"></span>`on_key_down` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::KeyEvent&)>` |  | A key pressed while focus is on the control or inside it, before the control's own handling; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_key_down()](../tree/element.md#on_key_down)). |
| <span id="uirelativepanel-on_wheel"></span>`on_wheel` | `ui::Callback<ui::Handling(const ui::PointerEvent&)>` |  | A wheel turn over the control, before the control scrolls; [ui::Handled](../core/namespace-ui.md#handled) stops it there ([Element::on_wheel()](../tree/element.md#on_wheel)). |
| <span id="uirelativepanel-control"></span>`control` | `ui::ControlOut<ui::RelativePanel>` |  | Out: the handle that receives the built control. |
| <span id="uirelativepanel-content"></span>`content` | `ui::RelativeItemList` |  | The constrained children; see [ui::RelativeItem](#uirelativeitem). |

Plus the common fields `style`, `margin`, `width`, `height`, `min_width`, `min_height`, `max_width`, `max_height`, `horizontal_alignment`, `vertical_alignment`, `visible`, `tool_tip`, `enabled`, `accessibility` every spec carries ([conventions](../conventions.md#common-fields-on-every-spec)).

### build

```cpp
std::unique_ptr<Element> build()&&
```

Consumes the spec and returns the built [ui::RelativePanelControl](#uirelativepanelcontrol); the caller owns it.

## `ui::RelativeItem`

One child of a [RelativePanel](#uirelativepanel). [`name`](#uirelativeitem-name) is what a sibling's constraints refer to it by. A constraint must name a sibling in the same panel. A name that matches none is a bug, caught by an assert in a debug build and otherwise left unset. Each string field is the [ui::RelativePanelConstraints](#struct-relativepanelconstraints) member of the same name; see [ui::RelativePanel](#uirelativepanel) for an example.

Every field, in the order a designated initializer names them:

```cpp
ui::RelativeItem{
    .name, .left_of, .above, .right_of, .below, .align_horizontal_center_with,
    .align_vertical_center_with, .align_left_with, .align_top_with, .align_right_with,
    .align_bottom_with, .align_left_with_panel, .align_top_with_panel, .align_right_with_panel,
    .align_bottom_with_panel, .align_horizontal_center_with_panel,
    .align_vertical_center_with_panel, .content
}
```

Fields, in declaration order (designators must follow it):

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <span id="uirelativeitem-name"></span>`name` | `std::string` |  | This child's name, for siblings to refer to. |
| <span id="uirelativeitem-left_of"></span>`left_of` | `std::string` |  | Sit left of the named sibling. |
| <span id="uirelativeitem-above"></span>`above` | `std::string` |  | Sit above the named sibling. |
| <span id="uirelativeitem-right_of"></span>`right_of` | `std::string` |  | Sit right of the named sibling. |
| <span id="uirelativeitem-below"></span>`below` | `std::string` |  | Sit below the named sibling. |
| <span id="uirelativeitem-align_horizontal_center_with"></span>`align_horizontal_center_with` | `std::string` |  | Share the named sibling's horizontal center. |
| <span id="uirelativeitem-align_vertical_center_with"></span>`align_vertical_center_with` | `std::string` |  | Share the named sibling's vertical center. |
| <span id="uirelativeitem-align_left_with"></span>`align_left_with` | `std::string` |  | Align left edges with the named sibling. |
| <span id="uirelativeitem-align_top_with"></span>`align_top_with` | `std::string` |  | Align top edges with the named sibling. |
| <span id="uirelativeitem-align_right_with"></span>`align_right_with` | `std::string` |  | Align right edges with the named sibling. |
| <span id="uirelativeitem-align_bottom_with"></span>`align_bottom_with` | `std::string` |  | Align bottom edges with the named sibling. |
| <span id="uirelativeitem-align_left_with_panel"></span>`align_left_with_panel` | `bool` | `false` | Pin to the panel's left edge. |
| <span id="uirelativeitem-align_top_with_panel"></span>`align_top_with_panel` | `bool` | `false` | Pin to the panel's top edge. |
| <span id="uirelativeitem-align_right_with_panel"></span>`align_right_with_panel` | `bool` | `false` | Pin to the panel's right edge. |
| <span id="uirelativeitem-align_bottom_with_panel"></span>`align_bottom_with_panel` | `bool` | `false` | Pin to the panel's bottom edge. |
| <span id="uirelativeitem-align_horizontal_center_with_panel"></span>`align_horizontal_center_with_panel` | `bool` | `false` | Center horizontally in the panel. |
| <span id="uirelativeitem-align_vertical_center_with_panel"></span>`align_vertical_center_with_panel` | `bool` | `false` | Center vertically in the panel. |

## `ui::RelativePanelControl`

Derives from `ui::Panel`.

Lays out children relative to each other and to the panel's edges.

Each child carries a [ui::RelativePanelConstraints](#struct-relativepanelconstraints) (sixteen constraints). A child is measured in the room its constraints leave it, then pinned: stretched between two anchored edges, placed against one, centered, or in the top-left corner when nothing is set. [`ui::RelativePanel`](#uirelativepanel) is the declarative form, referring to siblings by name.


### RelativePanelControl

```cpp
RelativePanelControl() = default
```

An empty panel with no border or padding.

### add

```cpp
template <typename T>
T* add(std::unique_ptr<T> child, RelativePanelConstraints constraints)
```

Takes ownership of `child` with its [`constraints`](#constraints) and returns a non-owning observer. Constraints may name siblings added later (set them with [`set_constraints()`](#set_constraints)).

### add

```cpp
template <SpecLike S>
Element* add(S&& spec, RelativePanelConstraints constraints)
```

The declarative overload: builds `spec` (or takes the node a [ui::Spec](../tree/spec-vocabulary.md#class-spec) holds) and adds it as [add()](#add) does a control. Returns the built node as an [Element](../tree/element.md), or nullptr for an empty [ui::Spec](../tree/spec-vocabulary.md#class-spec), which adds nothing; a spec's `.control` field gives a typed observer.

### add

```cpp
template <typename T>
T* add(std::unique_ptr<T> child)
```

[add()](#add) with no constraints set.

### add

```cpp
template <SpecLike S>
Element* add(S&& spec)
```

The declarative [add()](#add) with no constraints set.

### set_constraints

```cpp
void set_constraints(const Element* child, const RelativePanelConstraints& constraints)
```

Replaces a child's constraints; an element that is not a child is ignored.

### constraints

```cpp
RelativePanelConstraints constraints(const Element* child) const
```

A child's constraints; all unset for an element that is not a child.

### parallel_measure_safe

```cpp
bool parallel_measure_safe() const override
```

True: measuring touches only the panel and its children. The children are measured in dependency order on one thread.

### border_brush

```cpp
std::optional<Color> border_brush() const
```

The outline color; nullopt (the default) draws no border even with a non-zero [`border_thickness()`](#border_thickness). Nullopt as well while a [ThemeColor](../tree/theme-color.md) is set.

### border_brush_resource

```cpp
ThemeColor border_brush_resource() const
```

The theme resource the border is drawn from, or null.

### border_thickness

```cpp
const Thickness& border_thickness() const
```

The border width in DIPs per side (default zero); it insets the children like padding.

### corner_radius

```cpp
float corner_radius() const
```

The corner radius in DIPs, uniform for all four corners (default 0, square).

### padding

```cpp
const Thickness& padding() const
```

The padding in DIPs between the border and the children (default zero).

### set_border_brush

```cpp
void set_border_brush(std::optional<Color> color)
```

A fixed outline color; replaces any resource. Marks the panel for redraw.

### set_border_brush

```cpp
void set_border_brush(ThemeColor resource)
```

An outline color read from the theme each time the panel is drawn; replaces any fixed color. Marks the panel for redraw.

### set_border_thickness

```cpp
void set_border_thickness(const Thickness& thickness)
```

Sets the border width; marks the panel for layout and redraw.

### set_corner_radius

```cpp
void set_corner_radius(float radius)
```

Sets the corner radius; marks the panel for redraw.

### set_padding

```cpp
void set_padding(const Thickness& padding)
```

Sets the padding; marks the panel for layout.

### measure_override

```cpp
Size measure_override(Size available, const MeasureContext& context) const override
```

Resolves the dependency graph, measures each child in the room its constraints leave, and returns the widest and tallest chain plus border and padding.

### arrange_override

```cpp
void arrange_override(const Rect& final_rect, const ArrangeContext& context) override
```

Pins every child per its constraints inside the border and padding.

## struct RelativePanelConstraints

The placement constraints of one child of a [ui::RelativePanelControl](#uirelativepanelcontrol). A sibling reference is an observer of another child of the same panel; nullptr leaves that constraint unset.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `left_of` | `const Element*` | `nullptr` | Right edge against this sibling's left edge. |
| `above` | `const Element*` | `nullptr` | Bottom edge against this sibling's top edge. |
| `right_of` | `const Element*` | `nullptr` | Left edge against this sibling's right edge. |
| `below` | `const Element*` | `nullptr` | Top edge against this sibling's bottom edge. |
| `align_horizontal_center_with` | `const Element*` | `nullptr` | Horizontal center on this sibling's. |
| `align_vertical_center_with` | `const Element*` | `nullptr` | Vertical center on this sibling's. |
| `align_left_with` | `const Element*` | `nullptr` | Left edge in line with this sibling's. |
| `align_top_with` | `const Element*` | `nullptr` | Top edge in line with this sibling's. |
| `align_right_with` | `const Element*` | `nullptr` | Right edge in line with this sibling's. |
| `align_bottom_with` | `const Element*` | `nullptr` | Bottom edge in line with this sibling's. |
| `align_left_with_panel` | `bool` | `false` | Left edge on the panel's content edge. |
| `align_top_with_panel` | `bool` | `false` | Top edge on the panel's content edge. |
| `align_right_with_panel` | `bool` | `false` | Right edge on the panel's content edge. |
| `align_bottom_with_panel` | `bool` | `false` | Bottom edge on the panel's content edge. |
| `align_horizontal_center_with_panel` | `bool` | `false` | Centered horizontally in the panel. |
| `align_vertical_center_with_panel` | `bool` | `false` | Centered vertically in the panel. |

## class RelativeItemList

A [RelativePanel](#uirelativepanel)'s children, built; the names are resolved when the panel is. Callers write it as a braced list of [`ui::RelativeItem{...}`](#uirelativeitem).

### items_

```cpp
std::vector<Placed> items_
```

The placed children, in declaration order.

### RelativeItemList

```cpp
RelativeItemList() = default
```

An empty list.

### RelativeItemList

```cpp
template <typename... S>
RelativeItemList(S&& ... items)
    requires (sizeof...(S) > 0 && (std::same_as<S, RelativeItem> && ...))
```

Builds every item's content and takes ownership of it, keeping the constraints.

### RelativeItemList

```cpp
RelativeItemList(const RelativeItemList&) = delete
```

### operator=

```cpp
RelativeItemList& operator=(const RelativeItemList&) = delete
```

### RelativeItemList

```cpp
RelativeItemList(RelativeItemList&&) = default
```

### operator=

```cpp
RelativeItemList& operator=(RelativeItemList&&) = default
```

### add

```cpp
void add(RelativeItem item)
```

Builds `item`'s content and appends it, as one more entry of the braced list would.

### struct Placed

One built child with its constraints; the node is already owned by the list.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `names` | `RelativeItem` |  | The constraints; its content is already taken. |
| `node` | `std::unique_ptr<Element>` |  | The built child. |
